customers_say: Customers appreciate Aquaguard's product quality, installation, and water quality, while sentiments on value for money and reliability are mixed. reviews.body: I have just bought the equipment. On first glance, built quality is ok. It comes with an RO FILTER which is not required for my area. Anyone buying online please check your TDS level of water before buying. I will update on the product once I fully use it. Presently I am rating it 4 star because after receiving the item even for 2day on one came for installation. I had to call customer care of Amazon and only then the process started. I lost 4days due to this.
